newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks continue to consolidate at midday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks continue to consolidate at midday.

text.p: Wall Street shares were weak at midday Monday, still battling profit-taking in tech and large-capitalization stocks and nervous ahead of a speech by Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan on Tuesday.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average, which was hit by profit-taking Friday, was off 1.39 points at 7889. It moved off session lows as the New York Stock Exchange set, then lifted curbs on index-arbitrage trading.
The Nasdaq composite, whose technology stocks dragged the broader market lower last week, was down 11 points at 1537.
